title: New Starter Details
key_sentences: Please complete this form in block capitals and return it to People Services before your first day of work.
Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.
We use these details only to set up your employment, pay and pension records.
They are kept for six years after your employment ends and then deleted.
I confirm that the information I have given on this form is correct and complete.

list_items.text: 3. Bring your passport or birth certificate on your first day.
